nuisance_residualizer.behavior: Builds an orthonormal nuisance subspace by SVD over centered contrast rows from four required nuisance families, records nuisance_subspace_rank, and projects semantic class geometry against the full rank-r subspace.

queued_structural_executor.behavior: After full-subspace residualization, stacks all layer-21 nuisance rows, computes an SVD, selects only vh[0] as naxis, writes one holdout-nuisance cvec, and evaluates one nuisance_mean_abs_delta in the PASS logic.

successor_cross_task_gate.behavior: Defines a single NUISANCE control label. Causal rows are keyed per family/state/code/polarity/replicate and duplicate control labels fail, so the current evidence schema admits at most one NUISANCE row per causal cell.

new_material_finding.statement: The calibration residualizer can remove a multi-dimensional nuisance subspace, but both the queued structural executor and the new cross-task successor gate causally test only one nuisance intervention per evaluation cell. Full nuisance-subspace residualization is therefore stronger than the causal nuisance-control coverage used for promotion adjudication.
exact_source_logic: Residualizer: SVD nuisance matrix -> rank r -> q = vh[:r] -> semantic projection against all q rows.
Queued executor: SVD all nuisance rows -> naxis = vh[0] only -> one holdout-nuisance cvec.
Queued PASS: matched semantic effect is compared to one aggregate nuisance_mean_abs_delta, not the worst effect over every active nuisance basis direction or family-specific nuisance direction.
Cross-task gate: CONTROLS includes one literal NUISANCE; groups[key] rejects duplicate control labels, so multiple nuisance axes cannot be represented in one cell without schema/gate change.
new_material_finding.logical_consequence: If the admitted nuisance subspace has rank greater than one, an untested q[j>0] or family-specific nuisance direction could causally reproduce or exceed the target effect while the current successor evidence schema still has only one NUISANCE slot. A future PASS would therefore not, by itself, falsify all nuisance-direction explanations.
new_material_finding.important_limit: This audit does not assert that the exact executed nuisance rank is greater than one. If a future exact receipt proves rank=1, complete subspace coverage can be satisfied by one axis for that execution. The gate must either prove rank=1 or bind and test all active axes when rank>1.
new_material_finding.relationship_to_current_runtime_result: The independently reported T01 runtime already fails behavior and therefore blocks promotion regardless of this source-design gap. This finding matters chiefly so a repaired/successor discriminator cannot become falsely green after fixing the currently observed behavioral failure.

counterhypotheses.statement: The exact model/runtime calibration nuisance matrix may collapse to rank 1, in which case a single causally tested nuisance axis could be complete for that exact execution.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: Bind nuisance_subspace_rank and the exact orthonormal basis from the calibration receipt. If rank>1, one nuisance row is incomplete by construction.

counterhypotheses.statement: Even at rank>1, PC1 may dominate output behavior so strongly that other nuisance directions are irrelevant.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: Execute every admitted nuisance basis direction at the same frozen gain and compare target-margin effects per family/cell. Do not infer dominance from singular value alone because activation variance is not causal output effect.

successor_fix.name: RANK_COMPLETE_NUISANCE_CAUSAL_CONTROL_BINDING
required_schema_changes: Bind the calibration nuisance-subspace receipt/hash and exact nuisance_subspace_rank into the causal evidence candidate.
Add nuisance_axis_id or equivalent immutable direction identity to NUISANCE causal rows.
Permit and require one causal row for every admitted orthonormal nuisance basis axis q0..q(r-1) in each required evaluation cell when rank>1.
Optionally bind family-specific nuisance contrast directions as additional named controls where they are not exactly spanned or where nonlinear causal effects are a concern.
Reject missing, duplicated, unbound or post-holdout-selected nuisance axes.
required_pass_rule: For every target x output-code x polarity x replicate cell, require TARGET to beat NULL by the preregistered effect margin.
Require true SIGN_FLIP reversal as already specified by the successor gate.
Require TARGET to beat the worst causal effect over every bound nuisance axis, not only one PC1 or an average nuisance control.
Report nuisance-axis effects by family/cell and preserve the maximum adverse control rather than averaging away one failing axis.
If nuisance_subspace_rank is missing or greater than the number of causally bound nuisance axes, fail closed.
integration_with_other_run2_findings: Keep the exact target x output-code x query-polarity factorial introduced by the Run-2 polarity correction.
Keep proof-topology matching/stratification from the Run-2 proof-topology audit.
Keep token-position/length matching from the Run-2 last-token position-length audit.
Treat those newly identified structural factors as explicit nuisance families or design-orthogonalized factors rather than relying only on legacy lexical/code/compliance nuisance families.

research_delta: Forschungsrun 2 finds a nonduplicate promotion-control gap that survives the new cross-task gate: calibration removes an r-dimensional nuisance subspace, but causal adjudication exposes only one NUISANCE slot per cell. Promotion-grade evidence must either prove nuisance rank=1 or causally cover every bound nuisance axis and compare semantic steering against the worst nuisance effect.
next_exact_action: Do not modify or duplicate the frozen queued run. Update only the successor evidence schema/gate so nuisance rank and axis identities are bound and rank-complete causal nuisance coverage is mandatory before any future cross-task abstract-control PASS can be promoted.
